scope: Existing Take review and comment APIs, immutable comment history and exact feedback resolver. No Cut decision, approval, closure or generation executor is added in this commit.

migration.status: Applied in isolated DB fixtures and frozen. Integration must migrate and regrant/harden authorization functions.

observedBehavior: Fixed Take review identity, one open round under the immutable subject lock, same-key recovery and rejection of duplicate open rounds after cache expiry.
Only Take feedback is implemented; Cut, formal decisions and nonempty rework closure inputs are rejected.
Comments accept optional Take-local points/ranges, constrain parent comments to the same review and retain exact author and target.
Concurrent CAS edits produce one succeeding revision and one 412 conflict. Authors edit text; currently authorized project members resolve or reopen, each change appending immutable history.
Fixed feedback reads the requested original comment revision without silently using its current text; current head and resolved state are returned separately for generation freshness checks.
Runtime grants, forced RLS, guarded root mutation and a hardened NOLOGIN history trigger prevent direct SQL identity/author/time/history forgery.
Revoked members cannot replay cached comments, read history sources or mutate text; archived project feedback remains readable but cannot be edited. Standard API audit remains attributable.
limitations: CreateReview and createComment use the existing finite 24-hour HTTP receipt; comments have no permanent creation identity. Unknown clients must stop POST replay at expiry and preserve the original text for manual verification. Identical text does not prove creation success.
Exact history is exposed internally through resolveTakeFeedback; there is no new public comment history API.

Generation plan freshness, prepare_rework fixture execution and artifact handling are delivered by the parallel generation slice. Its existing prompt integration negative case must be updated for the required commentRevision.
No full-suite, browser, media decoding or real provider acceptance is claimed; parent performs integrated checks and actual browser verification.
isolation: Relational video rows exist only in isolated test schemas; existing media decoding acceptance is separate. No continuous runtime data or local services were changed.
